title: go-resty/resty v1
notes: Resty's first major version (gopkg.in/resty.v1). resty.New() with its host URL set, and a clone of net/http's default transport with MaxIdleConnsPerHost set to the number of lanes (resty v1 keeps net/http's two idle connections per host, and would open a new connection for most requests). SetResult(&out) has resty decode the JSON body (encoding/json) into an untyped value; the status is checked.
